pass_rule: Both calls must succeed under current OAuth authorization and return parseable current account state; empty/zero positions are valid known exposure, but permission errors are never PASS.
repair: Reconnect/re-authorize Longbridge OAuth with the full permissions required by the connector. Plain token refresh is insufficient because it preserves the old scopes.
persistence_rule: Never write balances, positions, account identifiers, or other private account values to the public repository. Runtime status only.
reauth_rule: Reconnect Longbridge and approve the full permission set requested by the connector (including watchlist/portfolio/trading OAuth scopes if presented). Plain token refresh or reconnect with the same limited scopes does not clear 403308.
pass_transition_rule: Only a fresh same-run success of BOTH account_balance and stock_positions may transition ACCOUNT to PASS.

last_reauth_attempt.error_message: Target API is not in authorized scope
last_reauth_attempt.interpretation: Connection refresh/re-authorization did not grant the connector scopes required by both read-only account endpoints.

execution_guard: Granting an OAuth trading scope does NOT authorize XRAY to place orders. XRAY execution remains NONE/REAL_MONEY=NO-GO and order/preview/replace/cancel endpoints remain forbidden.
